# EIR semantic baseline

This corpus is the migration oracle for canonical HIR and EIR work. Prefer the existing focused tests and smoke fixtures below instead of duplicating source programs.

| Semantic area | Existing coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Literals, locals, functions, calls, branches, loops | `core.kiro`, `tests/interpreter_v2.rs`, `tests/smoke/pass/test.kiro` |
| Lists, maps, indexing, mutation | `tests/interpreter_v2.rs`, `tests/check_diagnostics.rs` |
| Structs and fields | `tests/check_diagnostics.rs`, `tests/smoke/pass/verify_types.kiro` |
| Imports and nested module paths | `tests/interpreter_v2.rs`, `tests/smoke/pass/imports/` |
| Errors, checks, fallibility | `tests/interpreter_v2.rs`, `tests/smoke/pass/verify_error.kiro`, `tests/check_diagnostics.rs` |
| Purity and calls | `tests/async_semantics.rs`, `tests/smoke/pass/verify_pure*.kiro` |
| Move, reference, address behavior | `tests/smoke/pass/verify_move.kiro`, `tests/smoke/fail/verify_move*.kiro`, `tests/check_diagnostics.rs` |
| Host declarations and registered calls | `tests/interpreter_v2.rs`, `tests/host_contract.rs` |
| Pipes, `run`, and `rest` | `tests/interpreter_v2.rs`, `tests/async_semantics.rs`, `tests/check_diagnostics.rs` |
| Interpreter/Rust responsibility split | `tests/compiler_interpreter_split.rs` |

## Baseline differences recorded on 2026-08-13

- Running build-producing tests under parallel nextest can contaminate shared `.kiro/build` output across test binaries. Initial parallel runs produced two false imported-purity failures and seven runtime-diagnostic failures that observed output generated by another test.
- Running the same interpreter/compiler/async group serially passed all 30 tests, confirming those failures were test isolation rather than semantic differences.

This is a baseline test-harness limitation, not accepted target behavior. HIR/EIR work must not silently hide or expand it.
